headline: Egypt Secures $1 Billion World Bank Financing for Economic Reforms
summary: Egypt has signed a $1 billion financing agreement with the World Bank under the second phase of its Development Policy Financing programme. The funds aim to support economic reforms, enhance shock resilience, and advance green initiatives.
why: The World Bank provides development loans and financial assistance to help developing nations implement structural economic reforms and stabilize macroeconomies.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: World Bank development financing supports Egypt's fiscal position and structural reform agenda.
